GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-06-30T22:09:18Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Dont require declaration files after compile
Description: I use `import` instead of `<reference ..` to import my `d.ts` files. But after I'd compiled this:

``` ts
import 'tests/interfaces/mocha.d.ts';
```

I've got:

``` js
"use strict";
require('tests/interfaces/mocha.d.ts');
```

My config file:

``` json
{
    "compilerOptions": {
        "emitDecoratorMetadata": true,
        "experimentalDecorators": true,
        "module": "commonjs",
        "moduleResolution": "classic",
        "noImplicitAny": false,
        "outDir": "dist",
        "rootDir": ".",
        "sourceMap": true,
        "target": "es5"
    }
}
```

Can i change this behaviour by config?
